verdict.rationale: Airwallex docs say funds can be held in 20 currencies and converted at interbank rates (docs-16). Global Accounts receive local and SWIFT transfers into a single Wallet (docs-17, docs-18), FX conversion is available at market or guaranteed rates (docs-8), and AgentOS can read balances on the account (docs-13). Missing for 10: the 20-currency holding claim is framed for Banking-as-a-Service customers rather than a founder's own business account, there is no dedicated doc on viewing or managing multi-currency wallet balances, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
